text:
evan: deploybot attempted an unpin of runtime 5.1 for model=seqgen-x in canary during the 02:00 UTC change window but hit a conflict with a scheduled schema-migration job. Opening thread to coordinate next step.

deploybot: unpin request detected: runtime=5.1 -> 5.0 scheduled for canary-eu-central. Conflict: migration-job:schema-v12 running on the same host group, blocking rollout. Action: paused.

sam: what signal triggered the unpin originally?

evan: we had repeated tokenization mismatch failures for longprefix sampling at 5.1 (low volume but reproducible). QA validated 5.0 stable. Decision earlier was to unpin canary to 5.0 then run a targeted canary test with the schema migration paused.

rita: migration is a hard requirement for data pipeline; infra scheduled it at 02:10 UTC to finish before peak. If we force the unpin, we risk restarting nodes and interfering with the migration.

sam: options: (1) delay unpin until migration completes (~45m), (2) move unpin to alternate canary cohort (different host group), (3) cancel migration (not ideal).

evan: prefer option 2 — pick a different canary cohort that doesn't run the migration. We can then validate runtime 5.0 there and schedule a broader rollout after migration completes.

infra: alternative canary cohorts currently: canary-a (eu-central shard-4), canary-b (eu-central shard-9). Shard-9 is clean of migrations but is low-traffic; would still catch tokenization mismatch. ETA to target shard-9: immediate.

rita: if we go to shard-9, please annotate in release notes that the unpin was staged to an alternate canary to avoid migration interference. Also add a feature-flag gate so we can abort if migration needs the nodes.

evan: agreed. @deploybot please queue unpin to runtime=5.0 targeting canary-b (shard-9) with TTL 4h and annot "alt-canary-during-schema-mig" and set feature-flag gate "seqgen_unpin_alt_canary".

deploybot: acknowledged. Command queued:
```
/deploy unpin runtime=5.1 -> runtime=5.0 --target canary-b-shard-9 --ttl 4h --annot "alt-canary-during-schema-mig" --flag seqgen_unpin_alt_canary
```
deploybot: unpin starting in 2 minutes. Watch #eng-releases and #eng-runtime.

sam: after unpin completes, run a quick regression with these repro steps:
```
# repro longprefix tokenization mismatch
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"seqgen-x","prompt":"<longprefix>...","seq_len":4096}'
```
Check token counts and compare embedding hashes.

evan: will do. Also please capture config diffs so we can include them in the postmortem: kernel flags, quant profile, and tokenizer build id.

deploybot: unpin complete at 2876543400. Targeted canary-b-shard-9 now running runtime=5.0. TTL set to expire at 2876547000.

infra: note: feature-flag seqgen_unpin_alt_canary is ON for shard-9. If migration gets rescheduled to shard-9, the flag will auto-abort and rollback.

sam: ran the regression. Token counts normalized, mismatch gone on shard-9. p99 latency +0.2% (within noise). I'll post the diff artifact to the deploy ticket.

evan: thanks. Let's hold for migration completion and then coordinate staged unpin to broader regions in the next window. Rita, please confirm migration finished before we expand.

rita: migration completed at 2876543500, no node restarts required post-migration. You have green light to schedule regional rollforward.

evan: planning regional rollforward tomorrow 03:30 UTC with canary->regional->global gates. Drafting release note: "Temporary alternate-canary unpin for seqgen-x due to tokenization mismatch; validated on shard-9; regional rollforward scheduled."

sam: also requesting a follow-up to add tokenization-version to runtime compatibility matrix to prevent future auto-pins. Filing ticket now.

evan: closing this ops thread for the immediate alt-canary unpin. Keep updates here if the flag triggers or if deploybot reports further conflicts. :white_check_mark:
